name: 28532 · Havelock, NC
findings: ZIP 28532 (Havelock) has 40 nonprofit organizations. 16 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 14 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (47% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 28532 (Havelock) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 28532 (Havelock) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 72% of the typical level).
